summary: Iteration 16 — Self-serve admin distribution (paste-a-URL connectors) + one-shot publishing/scheduling from Ad Studio. Backend pytest 13/13 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_distribution_iter16.py: GET /api/admin/distribution/types returns all 14 connector types (discord, telegram, x_twitter, linkedin, reddit, mastodon, bluesky, pinterest, threads, slack, zapier, make, ifttt, webhook) with proper fields[] structure (each has key+label) and at least one instant:true among the new five (verified slack, zapier, make, ifttt, webhook all instant=True). POST /api/admin/distribution/connectors creates a webhook connector with config={url:'https://httpbin.org/post'} → 200 with platform_label='Generic Webhook (any URL accepting POST JSON)'. Missing required fields → 400 'Missing required field'; unknown platform → 400 'Unknown platform'. POST /api/admin/distribution/broadcast with webhook connector + an existing ad id returns summary {ok:1, failed:0, total:1}; post_count incremented from 0→1 verified via direct Mongo read. Slack with fake URL https://hooks.slack.com/services/INVALID/INVALID/INVALID via /connectors/{cid}/test → HTTP 502 (NOT 500) with FastAPI detail='Test failed: Slack ...' — mapping correct. Zapier with hook_url=https://httpbin.org/status/404 via /broadcast → 200 with summary.failed=1 (NOT 5xx on our side). IFTTT with event_name='lumo_test'+key='fake-key' → POST to https://maker.ifttt.com/trigger/lumo_test/with/key/fake-key, IFTTT returns 401, our backend maps it to broadcasts[].status='failed' (not 5xx). Make with hook_url=https://httpbin.org/post → status='ok', post_count incremented. POST /api/admin/distribution/schedule-once with run_at=now+5min returns 200 with one_shot=true, enabled=true, next_run_at set; run_at in the past → 400; missing ad_id → 404. _run_due_schedules loop verified: inserted a one_shot schedule directly into MongoDB with next_run_at=(now-1min) and a real webhook connector to httpbin; within 70s the schedule's enabled flipped to false AND posts_sent incremented to ≥1 (asserted both). Frontend (Playwright on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, admin@lumo.test login → /admin → Ad Studio): each of the 22 library ad cards has data-testid='ad-publish-{id}' (Send icon button); clicking ad-publish-{id} opens data-testid='ad-publish-dialog' with the enabled Discord connector pre-checked (data-testid='ad-publish-channel-{cid}'); submit button data-testid='ad-publish-submit' (label 'Publish now') fires POST /api/admin/distribution/broadcast — verified by intercepting the network request — and shows success toast 'Posted to 1 channel'. From the preview pane (latest ad rendered after generate / load), data-testid='ad-publish-now' (teal 'Publish now' button) and data-testid='ad-schedule' (outline 'Schedule…' button) both render. Clicking ad-schedule opens the dialog in 'later' mode; data-testid='ad-publish-runat' is a datetime-local input pre-filled to ~1h from now (read value e.g. '2026-06-25T18:42' when test ran at ~17:42); submit label is 'Schedule it' and clicking fires POST /api/admin/distribution/schedule-once (network intercept confirmed). Regression: /admin → Distribution tab still loads — Add-a-channel picker shows all the new types under 'Works instantly' (Discord Webhook, Telegram Channel, Slack (Incoming Webhook), Zapier (Catch Hook) → routes to X / FB / IG / LinkedIn / Pinterest, Make.com (Custom Webhook), IFTTT (Webhooks → applet), Generic Webhook (any URL accepting POST JSON)) — each tagged ✓ no signup needed; the dev-token group (X / Twitter, LinkedIn Company Page, Reddit, Mastodon, Bluesky, Pinterest, Threads (Meta)) renders below. Existing 'Your channels (1)' row (Lumo Discord channel · 3 posts) still renders with Test / toggle / delete actions. Regression: Analytics tab still works — data-testid='analytics-page' and data-testid='analytics-tiles' both present.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py CONNECTOR_TYPES + POSTERS extension is clean and additive — instant-OAuth-less channels (slack/zapier/make/ifttt/webhook) reuse the same poster contract (cfg, ad, image_full_url) → dict, so the broadcast/test/scheduler loops needed zero changes beyond the POSTERS.update().

test_connector() correctly wraps poster exceptions into HTTPException(502, 'Test failed: ...'); broadcast_ad() catches per-connector exceptions and records broadcasts[].status='failed' WITHOUT raising — so a single bad URL never 5xx's the whole request. Verified.
schedule_one_shot validates run_at is parseable ISO and in the future; uses datetime.fromisoformat with Z→+00:00 normalisation and naive→UTC promotion. Mathematically sound.
_run_due_schedules now branches on s.get('one_shot') — sets enabled=false + $inc posts_sent. Non-one_shot path still advances ad_cursor + recomputes next_run_at. Clean diff.
AdStudio.jsx publish dialog correctly defaults pickedIds to all enabled connectors and disables submit when pickedIds.length===0 — UX guardrail in place.
runAtLocal pre-fill uses Date(now+1h) formatted in local clock (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm) — submitPublish converts to ISO via new Date(runAtLocal).toISOString() before POST; correct timezone handling.
Minor nit: the POSTERS dict is mutated via POSTERS.update() AFTER the dict is initially declared; would be slightly cleaner as a single literal but functionally identical.
Minor nit: schedule_one_shot returns 200 not 201; the spec called out '201/200' so this is acceptable, but POST-creating returning 201 would be more REST-canonical.

Minor: distribution_types endpoint does not strip the 'todo' field for connectors that have one — UI receives it (and uses it as the 'Implementation pending' tooltip), so this is intentional, not a leak.
post_count on the connector doc has no atomic ceiling — fine, just noting that for high-volume schedules a monthly counter rollover may be desired later.

test_credentials: admin@lumo.test / password123 (seeded). Httpbin.org used as safe webhook target. Fake Slack/Zapier/IFTTT URLs used per spec to verify error mapping.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed connectors (webhook, slack, zapier, ifttt, make ×2) and 1 TEST_ one_shot ad_schedule directly in Mongo. Session-scope teardown fixture purges all connectors with name regex ^TEST_ and ad_schedules matching ^TEST_|^One-shot. Final manual sweep also deleted 1 stray 'One-shot · Turn Your Property Into Profit With Lumo' schedule left over from the UI flow. Final Mongo state: 0 TEST_ connectors, 0 TEST_ schedules, 0 TEST_ ads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Slack /test with an invalid URL returns 502 from FastAPI but on this deployment the ingress sometimes serves an HTML 502 instead of the JSON detail body — the test tolerates both (status code is the source of truth, not the body). Httpbin.org is a stable target for webhook smoke tests. _run_due_schedules wakes every 60s — when testing one_shot auto-disable, allow up to 75s wall time. The scheduler one_shot path also $inc's posts_sent on the schedule doc (not just on connector.post_count) — assert that too. AdStudio publish dialog defaults pickedIds to all enabled connectors; if no connector is enabled, the dialog shows data-testid='ad-publish-empty' and the submit is disabled. Distribution tab has no role='tab' attribute reachable via Playwright get_by_role on this deployment — use get_by_text('Distribution', exact=True).first.click(force=True) instead. Auto-pilot 4h Sora video generation is queued for next iteration — do NOT test for it yet.
rca of the issue: No defects discovered. Implementation matches spec exactly: 14 connector types listed, 5 new instant ones (slack/zapier/make/ifttt/webhook) all working via paste-a-URL with no OAuth, error mapping is per-connector (502 on test, broadcasts[].status='failed' on broadcast, never 5xx the whole request), schedule-once → one_shot schedule that the existing _run_due_schedules loop picks up and auto-disables after a single fire. Frontend dialog wiring (preview pane CTAs + library send icons) calls the correct endpoints with the correct payload shape.
